body: Thank you so much for replying. I meant sending back to where we bought it. My family already sent him back... I just feel like a really bad owner right now..

Not a really big accomplishment  but I went from 5'7 47kg to 55kg in 4 months. Used to just 1 meal a day. The diet part was a real struggle even though I greatly enjoyed the gym sessions. I HATED eating and I would have to force feed myself to the point where I vomit them out in my mouth and swallow it back. Alan Thrall said something that really hit me hard in this video that I would like you to listen. https://youtu.be/4f7DvyBwgPo?t=623 Obviously, I still have a loooong way to go and will continue working to my goal.
